items.information:
1. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MumbaiMonsoonMayhem2026#75563-new-competitor-information) tab before registering. 

2. All competitors should be familiar with the information in all the tabs. Check out all the Tabs for more detailed information.

3. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.

4. Make sure you are available at the venue at least 20 minutes prior to your respective event's start time. 

5. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. 

6. No exceptions will be made unless discussed with the WCA Delegates in advance (contact us via the "Contact Us" tab)

7. The final decision and rights to accept/deny the exeception request remains with the WCA Delegates. 

8. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification.

items.information:
## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español
   
## Bienvenido al Road to Nats Maracay 2026

**Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.**

* Límite de **50 competidores** para el registro.
* Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia.
* **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsMaracay2026#76349-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla.
* Si tiene dudas, contactar al equipo organizador.

#### 📸 Aviso de Filmación
Al asistir a **Road to Nats Maracay 2026**, autorizas a la organización a tomar fotografías y grabar videos durante el evento. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso.

## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English 
## Welcome to Road to Nats Maracay 2026

**Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.**

* Competitor registration limit: **50**.
* It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience.
* **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsMaracay2026#76349-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) for you. It is very important to read it.
* If you have any questions, contact the organizing team.

#### 📸 Filming Notice
By attending **Road to Nats Maracay 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice.
